an6.102:1.1: cha bhikkhave ānisaṃse sampassamānena alameva bhikkhunā sabbasaṃkhāresu anodhiṃ karitvā aniccasaññaṃ upaṭṭhapetuṃ
an6.102:1.3: sabbasaṃkhārā ca anavaṭṭhitato khāyissanti sabbaloke ca me mano nābhiramissati sabbalokā ca me mano vuṭṭhahissati nibbānapoṇañca me mānasaṃ bhavissati saññojanā ca me pahānaṃ gacchanti paramena ca sāmaññena samannāgato bhavissāmīti
an6.102:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave cha ānisaṃse sampassamānena alameva bhikkhunā sabbasaṃkhāresu anodhiṃ karitvā aniccasaññaṃ upaṭṭhapetunti. 103
